title: Make glass at the Corning Museum

location.label: Corning Museum of Glass, New York

description: Visit Corning’s galleries to see how artists have shaped glass across centuries, then step into the Studio for a Make Your Own Glass session. With staff guiding the process, you choose a project and take part in making an object from a material normally encountered only after it has cooled. Watch a live demonstration while you are there.
teaser: Try glassmaking after exploring the museum’s collection.
goodToKnow: Short sessions may be available. Confirm the current studio schedule, class format and access before reserving.
whyItMightDelightYou: Handling the process yourself changes how you see every delicate object in the galleries.
